sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We targeted the EGFR locus in Homo sapiens (GRCh38) using Cas9. The PAM motif was NGG. Guides were designed with CHOPCHOP. Lentivirus delivered the editor into K562 cells (RRID:CVCL_0004). A non-targeting control was included. Editing was measured by T7E1 (n = 3 biological replicates). Off-target analysis used Cas-OFFinder. Cells were harvested 48 hours after transduction. Culture used RPMI at 37 °C. Statistics used one-way ANOVA.
